techNotes: DUE TO THE NOISE ONLY PRESENT A 70MPH HAD TO DRIVE THE CAR OUT ON THE INTERSTATE TO VERIFY THE NOISE. WHEN ON TEST DRIVE HEARD TAPPING NOISE FROM THE LOWER PART OF THE VEHICLE. DROVE CAR BACK TO THE SHOP. DURING A VISUAL INSPECTION OF THE LOWER PART OF THE CAR FOUND LOOSE BOLT FOR THE LEFT UNDER COVER. PROPERLY TIGHTEN THE UNDER COVER BOLT AND DROVE THE CAR BACK TO THE INTERSTATE TO VERIFY THE NOISE WAS GONE. NO MORE TAPPING NOISE WAS HEARD FROM THE CAR AT 70MPH NOW. DUE TO HAVING TO DRIVE ON THE INTERSTATE 34 MILES WAS DRIVING ON THE CAR TO VERIFY THE CONCERN.
